rewrite.name: crate paths and dependency paths are rewritten
rewrite.text:
use crate::x::Y;
fn f() { crate::z(); dep_a::q(); }
rewrite.expected:
use crate::m_self::x::Y;
fn f() { crate::m_self::z(); crate::m_a::q(); }

rewrite.name: a path behind another path is left alone
a field or method call is left alone
a macro dollar crate is left alone
a name that is not followed by a path is left alone
rewrite.text: fn f() { let dep_a = 1; dep_a.f(); crate_x(); }
rewrite.expected: fn f() { let dep_a = 1; dep_a.f(); crate_x(); }

rewrite.name: strings and comments are left alone
rewrite.text:
// crate::x and dep_a::y
fn f() { let _ = "crate::x dep_a::y"; }
rewrite.expected:
// crate::x and dep_a::y
fn f() { let _ = "crate::x dep_a::y"; }

rewrite.name: an extern prelude path is left alone
